bridges.crates/app/src/app.rs: One State slot and adapter calls; shared start/act, add policy and async torrent lifecycle must follow upstream changes.

bridges.crates/ipc/src/api.rs: Additive optional source and request-id fields; regenerate the schema.
bridges.crates/torrent/src/lib.rs: Additive offline inspection module/export only; preserve upstream torrent engine.

bridges.crates/remote/src/lib.rs: Owner auth modules/state and recovery hooks in the existing upstream server.

bridges.crates/remote/src/devices.rs: Scope and owner-controlled device management; preserve native device compatibility.
bridges.extension/background.js: Adapter loading plus transport, status, rules and popup call sites; preserve local capture behavior.
bridges.extension/manifest.json: Fork name/artwork, stable protocol identity and adapter worker.
bridges.extension/popup.html: Fork-facing name/artwork; preserve native and remote popup controls.
bridges.extension/popup.js: Server connection state, destination preservation and Web UI opening.
bridges.tools/extension/test.mjs: Explicit remote regression harness hook and both browser script loaders.
bridges.tools/extension/pack.ps1: Include remote.js in every shipped extension variant.
bridges.tools/extension/check-pack.mjs: Validate adapter inclusion and loading order.
bridges.tools/extension/e2e.mjs: DevTools fallback while preserving original browser checks.
bridges.tools/i18n/extract.py: Recursive Rust module discovery plus one fork-owned collector hook.

bridges..gitattributes: LF for generated catalogs, fork deployment files and Bash smoke scripts.
bridges.docker/compose.yml: Fork deployment configuration; preserve data and explicit network settings.
